draft.emotion: friendly and approachable, offering a polite or warm observation
notes: Notice the common pattern 'nett von jemandem' (nice/kind of someone).
To express deeper warmth or affection, 'lieb' (sweet, dear) or 'herzlich' (warm-hearted) is often preferred over 'nett'.

draftBefore.emotion: friendly and approachable, offering a polite or warm observation
notes: Nett is an extremely common, versatile word in German. It is often used to describe someone as friendly or a situation as pleasant, but it can occasionally sound lukewarm or patronizing depending on the context.
If you want to emphasize deep, genuine kindness or warmth, you might choose words like 'herzlich' (warm-hearted) or 'lieb' (sweet/dear) instead of just 'nett'.
